web:ti-snvsbd5d-lm61460.note: p.1: VQFN-HR (14), body 4.00 x 3.50 mm nom. p.3 device comparison: LM61460AANRJRR = LM61460AAN, auto mode, no spread spectrum, adjustable output and frequency. p.4 absolute maximum: VIN1/VIN2 to AGND/PGND -0.3 to 42 V; EN/SYNC -0.3 to 42 V; SW -0.3 to VIN+0.3 V (2 V below GND for <=200 ns); PGND to AGND +/-0.3 V DC. p.5-6 electrical (VIN 13.5 V, TJ -40..150 C): VEN rising 1.263 V typ (+/-5 %), hysteresis 24-32 %, EN/SYNC edge 2.4 V for sync; fADJ 0.18/0.2/0.22 MHz (RT 66.5k), 0.36/0.4/0.44 MHz (RT 33.2k), 1.98/2.2/2.42 MHz (RT 5.76k); RDS(ON)_HS 41 typ / 82 max mOhm, RDS(ON)_LS 21 / 45 mOhm; IL-HS 8.9 / 10.3 / 11.5 A (duty approaching 0 %), IL-LS 6.1 / 7.1 / 8.1 A. p.7 timing: tON_MIN 55 typ / 70 max ns (VIN 20 V, 2 A); tOFF_MIN 65 typ / 85 max ns (VIN 4.0 V, IOUT 1 A); tSS 3.5/5/7 ms; hiccup wait 80 ms. tOFF_MIN is a device limit: the datasheet gives no value per output voltage or frequency. p.30 eq. (8): fSW <= (VINeff(MIN2) - VOUT) / (VINeff(MIN2) x tOFF_MIN(MAX)), VINeff(MIN2) = VIN(MIN2) - IOUT(MAX) x (RDS(ON)_HS(MAX) + DCR(MAX)). Arithmetic (this read, MODEL, ideal parts): VOUT 12 V, IOUT 4.2 A (C4 gate), RDS(ON)_HS 82 mOhm max, DCR 20.0 mOhm max (SRP7030-2R2M and SRP7028A-2R2M rows), tOFF_MIN 85 ns max -> lowest VIN before frequency foldback 12.85 V at 0.4 MHz, 13.54 V at 1.0 MHz, 15.04 V at 2.1 MHz. p.31 eq. (10): L >= 0.32 x VOUT / fSW when the design runs near or in dropout; eq. (11): L >= 0.2 x VOUT / fSW when the duty factor stays below 50 %; the inductor Isat must not be less than IL-HS. Units follow the datasheet example (VOUT 5 V, 400 kHz, 4.7 uH chosen; eq. 10 gives 4.0 uH). Arithmetic for SYS12: duty 12/16.8..12/13.2 = 0.71..0.91 (ideal), so eq. (10) applies: L >= 3.84 uH at 1.0 MHz, 9.6 uH at 0.4 MHz; a 2.2 uH part meets eq. (10) only from 1.75 MHz (0.32 x 12 / 2.2), where eq. (8) gives about 14.7 V. The SHRINK-2 pairing LM61460 + 2.2 uH at a sync of 1.0 MHz or less therefore conflicts with eq. (10) (flag for GR-5A; not decided here). pp.55-56 RJR0014A (VQFN-HR, 1 mm max height): body 3.9-4.1 x 3.4-3.6 mm, height 0.8-1.0 mm; land pattern example (exposed metal, scale 25x): pad-row centre lines 3.2 apart (pins 1-5 / 6-9 side) and 2.9 (pins 9 / 11 L-pads), reference dimensions as drawn: pin 10 pad (2.4) x (0.4); seven pads (0.7) long, six of them (0.25) wide; three small left-side pads (0.3) tall at (0.525) pitch; four L-shaped VIN/PGND corner pads (1) tall with (0.4) feet and (0.35)/(0.4) wide arms; pad-row centre-line spans (3.2) on the pin 1-5 side and (2.9) on the pin 9-11 side; (1.85) from the left pad column to the package centre line; R0.05 typ and R0.12 corners; solder mask 0.07 max (NSMD) or 0.07 min (SMD) all around. The RJR0014A land pattern is not in the KiCad 10.0.7 library (see web:kicad-10.0.7-footprint-check).
